param: k Fraction of human recruitment that is vaccinated (vaccination rate at birth)
θ Rate of vaccine immunity loss (waning vaccine protection)
ε Vaccine efficacy (reduces susceptibility to mosquito-borne infection)
β₁ Effective contact rate for vaccinated humans with infectious mosquitoes (vector-borne), scaled by vaccine efficacy ε in equations
β₂ Effective contact rate for susceptible humans with infectious mosquitoes (vector-borne)
α₁ Effective contact rate for vaccinated humans with infectious humans via non-vector pathways (blood transfusion/healthcare/congenital/organ transplant)
α₂ Effective contact rate for susceptible humans with infectious humans via non-vector pathways
β₃ Effective contact rate for susceptible mosquitoes with infectious humans (human-to-mosquito transmission through blood meals)
τ₁ Progression rate from vector-exposed humans to infectious humans
τ₂ Progression rate from non-vector-exposed humans to infectious humans
σ Progression rate from infectious humans to treated humans
ω Recovery rate from treated humans to recovered humans
γ Loss of immunity rate for recovered humans (returns to susceptible)
δ₁ Disease-induced death rate for infectious humans (and used also for treated humans in the given equations)
φ Progression rate from exposed mosquitoes to infectious mosquitoes
